messages:
Maya: RC created: rc/3.2.0.1. Includes runtime batching tweak, kernel selection fallback fixes, and a small metrics tag change. Requesting sign-off for promotion to prod in tomorrow's 11:00-12:00 UTC change window. Release notes: https://go/release/rc-3.2.0.1 and artifacts pinned sha256:abc123def456
Sam: running a quick staging smoke now, will report in 10m
deploy-bot: CI/Int tests passed for rc/3.2.0.1. Artifact pushed to registry (sha256:abc123def456). Canary image tagged rc-3.2.0.1-canary
Jo (QA): did a quick smoke on staging: 2 transient 500s hitting proxy at t+2m, retries succeeded. Captured logs and stack traces here: https://go/logs/rc-3.2-smoke (short snippets attached)
Anya: can we tighten the change window to 11:15-11:45 UTC to match oncall availability? otherwise fine
Lee: suggest rollout plan: canary 5% for 10m monitoring 95th latency + error rate, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if metrics stable. Auto-rollback threshold: 3% error OR 2x baseline p95 for >5m
Maya: agree with Lee. Rollback plan: pin traffic back to stable rc/3.1.9 and spin old nodes; runbook: https://go/runbooks/rc-rollback. I'll be the promoter and will trigger the staged rollout at 11:15 if no objections
Elena: product sign-off: OK. Note in release notes that kv_cache param is deprecated behaviorally (will log warnings)
Sam: second smoke run, 15m of steady traffic on staging, no errors, p95 within baseline. attaching perf graphs
Anya: :thumbsup: from infra side, we'll be standing by to flip the pin if needed
Maya: will post final pre-promote checklist 10m before. Please react when ready
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by Maya for 2026-03-21T11:15:00Z (triggered at 1898765500). Starting staged rollout: step 1/4 -> canary 5%
deploy-bot: Canary metrics 8m in: errors 0.6% (baseline 0.3%), p95 +10% (within threshold). Continuing to 25%
deploy-bot: Step 2/4 -> 25% traffic at 1898765560. Monitoring 20m
Jo (QA): watching post-deploy checks. No functional regressions observed in smoke tests so far
deploy-bot: Final step 4/4 -> promote to 100% at 1898765615. All services healthy, no rollback triggered. Release notes updated with final tag rc-3.2.0.1. Congrats team :tada:
Maya: thanks all — will open a follow-up doc for post-promote metrics and cost delta analysis
